params.description: The namespace for the metric data

params.description: The name of the metric

params.name: MetricData.member.1.Value
params.description: The value for the metric

params.description: The time the metric data was received

params.name: MetricData.member.1.Unit
params.description: The unit of the metric

params.name: MetricData.member.1.Dimensions.member.1.Name
params.description: The name of the dimension

params.name: MetricData.member.1.Dimensions.member.1.Value
params.description: The value of the dimension

items.docs: Publishes metric data points to Amazon CloudWatch. CloudWatch associates the data points with the specified metric. If the specified metric does not exist, CloudWatch creates the metric. When CloudWatch creates a metric, it can take up to fifteen minutes for the metric to appear in calls to ListMetrics.

params.name: StartTime
params.description: The start of the time range to retrieve metric data

params.name: EndTime
params.description: The end of the time range to retrieve metric data

params.name: MetricDataQueries.member.1.Id
params.description: A short name to identify the query

params.name: MetricDataQueries.member.1.MetricStat.Metric.Namespace
params.description: The namespace of the metric

params.name: MetricDataQueries.member.1.MetricStat.Metric.MetricName
params.description: The name of the metric

params.name: MetricDataQueries.member.1.MetricStat.Period
params.description: The granularity in seconds of the returned data points

params.name: MetricDataQueries.member.1.MetricStat.Stat
params.description: The statistic to return (e.g., Average, Sum, Maximum)

params.name: MaxDatapoints
params.description: The maximum number of data points to return

params.name: NextToken
params.description: Token for the next page of results

items.docs: Retrieves CloudWatch metric values. You can use GetMetricData to retrieve as many as 500 different metrics in a single request, with a total of as many as 100,800 data points.

info.name: Amazon CloudWatch Get statistics for a metric

params.name: Namespace
params.description: The namespace of the metric

params.name: MetricName
params.description: The name of the metric

params.name: StartTime
params.description: The start of the time range for the data points

params.name: EndTime
params.description: The end of the time range for the data points

params.name: Period
params.description: The granularity in seconds of the returned data points

params.name: Statistics.member.1
params.description: The metric statistic to return

params.name: Dimensions.member.1.Name
params.description: The name of the dimension

params.name: Dimensions.member.1.Value
params.description: The value of the dimension

params.name: Unit
params.description: The unit for the metric

items.docs: Gets statistics for the specified metric. The maximum number of data points returned from a single call is 1,440. CloudWatch retains metric data as follows: data points with a period of less than 60 seconds are available for 3 hours, 60-second data points for 15 days, 5-minute data points for 63 days, and 1-hour data points for 455 days.

params.name: Namespace
params.description: Filter by namespace

params.name: MetricName
params.description: Filter by metric name

params.name: Dimensions.member.1.Name
params.description: The name of the dimension to filter by

params.name: Dimensions.member.1.Value
params.description: The value of the dimension to filter by

params.name: NextToken
params.description: Token for the next page of results

params.name: RecentlyActive
params.description: Filter to metrics that have had data points published in the past three hours

items.docs: List the specified metrics. You can use the returned metrics with GetMetricData or GetMetricStatistics to get statistical data. Up to 500 results are returned for any one call.
